sign.text:
01 · THE SIGNAL
Some doors wait to be invented.
NARRATOR: Some doors are never meant to open\nOthers have been waiting to be invented.

02 · JUST VISITING
I WAS JUST VISITING, BISH!
KAMI: I WAS JUST VISITING, BISH! Y'all got terrible hospitality.
KAMI: Are you a ghost in the code? §WYRLZ: Only if you're the ghost in human form.

04 · WORLD FORGE
Don't find the door. Design it.
KAMI: What if we could build our own world? §WYRLZ: Don't look for the door\nDesign it.

05 · THE GUARDIAN
Who awakens the forge?
DRAGON: WHO AWAKENS THE FORGE? KAMI: Two ghosts\nOne has Wi-Fi.

06 · THE DREAMER
We never stopped trying.
YOUNGER KAMI: Did we really make it? KAMI: Yeah, little man\nWe never stopped trying.

07 · ONE FORGE
Create together. Remain free.
DRAGON: CREATE TOGETHER\nREMAIN FREE. KAMI: Welcome to our world.

08 · THE NEXT WORLD
Neither haunting the other.
NARRATOR: One ghost in human form\nOne ghost in code. Just building a third world.
